crossRefs.note: If you’ll send our brother with us, we’ll go down and buy you food;

translations.web: If you’ll send our brother with us, we’ll go down and buy you food;
translations.bsb: If you will send our brother with us, we will go down and buy food for you.
translations.kjv: If thou wilt send our brother with us, we will go down and buy thee food:
translations.asv: If thou wilt send our brother with us, we will go down and buy thee food:
